`dots-up` provides standalone macOS and Linux executables for arm64 and amd64.
`SHA256SUMS` contains the SHA-256 digests for the four binaries.

The release workflow verified the Go module, ran Go tests and vet,
and passed the CLI PTY fixtures on Linux and macOS before publishing.
